stemMd: Five measurements have mean 12. A sixth measurement of 18 is added. What is the new mean?
explanationMd: The original total is 5 times 12=60. Add 18 to obtain 78 across six measurements, so the mean is 78/6=13.

distractorRationale.c: This does not preserve the original total.
distractorRationale.e: This uses only the added measurement.
distractorRationale.d: This averages the old mean and the new value with equal weights.
